decision: Discard the 32-bit memory MOV 8B / LEA 8D duplicated effective-address decoder; paired whole-guest gain was below the predeclared 10% threshold

workload.command: XV6_LEAN=1 XV6_FIRMWARE=bochs XV6_STEPS=40000000 XV6_STOP_ON_EXPECT=1 XV6_COMMAND=$'forktest\r' XV6_EXPECT_SERIAL=$'fork test OK\n$ ' node scripts/probe-xv6-stock.mjs

candidate.change: For default 32-bit unoverridden 8B/8D forms, compute ModRM/SIB effective address inline without allocating the generic EA descriptor; ordinary fetch, segment and paging helpers still enforce faults.
candidate.focusedTests: Three tests passed for six addressing forms, page-fault rollback, and a changed code displacement.

guestEquality.normalization: Set worktree-specific ROM and image path strings to empty; all other complete report fields match in every run.

limits: The first pair favored the candidate while the reverse-order pair did not. Duplicating effective-address logic for this noisy 1.3% mean gain would add maintenance and fault risk. The candidate and its dedicated tests were not merged.
